Click a button element and verify success

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { BrowserMode, PageAction, createEngine, interact } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = { browser: { mode: BrowserMode.Always } };
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await interact(engine, url, [{ selector: "#submit", type: "click" } as PageAction]);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].success);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionType);
  console.log(result.actionResults[0].actionIndex);
}

void main();
```
